title: Roswell operators part of the craft's guidance system

tellings.quote: interviews with him, he he said that the operators of specifically the Roswell craft were part of the guidance system.

plain: The beings who flew the craft said to have crashed near Roswell, New Mexico, in 1947 were supposedly part of the craft's own guidance system, not just its pilots. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb says this comes from interviews with a man named Philip J. Corso, who "said that the operators of specifically the Roswell craft were part of the guidance system." If true, the craft and its crew would have worked together as one machine.
